name: go-static-embedded-binary
body: kalide is written in Go and ships as a single self-contained static binary per supported target — darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64, windows/amd64, windows/arm64, linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 — each gated purely on GitHub-hosted native runner availability, with no external runtime or network dependency at run time. Only the core of the tool is embedded via Go embed: the vendored reveal.js runtime, the core page shells (deck, error, gallery), the minimal `kalide init` seed scaffold, the static, text-only author-guide scaffold files (requirements.requirement.agent-authoring) — the deck-author full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` and its short `AGENTS.md` pointer, and the library/template-author full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` and its `AGENTS.md` pointer (requirements.requirement.agent-guide-reference) — and the scaffold-version digest catalog (global.constraint.upgrade-known-version-catalog); the embedded core carries no brand (global.constraint.core-unbranded). Templates, themes, fonts, logos and other media are read at run time from the resolved library root (the configured `templates:` path, else the local `templates/`; global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets).
